diagnosis.explanation: The fitting's widget guidance always said to clone built-in plugins (shell-guide note, map 'Customizing a built-in widget', L4). All three fitted runs cloned the clock and swapped the layout id away from omarchy.clock. Vanilla runs just edited the existing widget's format option in shell.json.

The fitting already names o.launch_on_start for autostart.lua. Both fitted runs read helpers.lua, worried that the uwsm-app wrapper would not expand $HOME, and switched to o.exec_on_start. Nothing in the fitting suggested that. Vanilla used launch_on_start and passed, so a small map clarification is a cheap nudge.

- Only to change a widget's code: run `omarchy plugin clone omarchy.<name>`, then edit `.config/omarchy/plugins/<username>.<name>/`. Cloning switches the bar to the clone. Never edit the packaged copy.
